title: Stardew Valley: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
summary: Stardew Valley's Nintendo Switch 2 Edition arrived as a surprise release on December 25, 2025, and owners of the Switch 1 version can upgrade for free. The Switch 2 Edition adds mouse controls, four-player split-screen co-op on one console, online play for up to eight farmers, and GameShare, so friends can join from one copy. No resolution or frame rate figures have been published. At 2.2 GB (1.5 GB on Switch 1) it is one of the smallest games on the system, and the physical release has the full game on the cartridge.
